C4.for_what_part: It shows that no other table, no other column and no deletion appears in the staged set. The live tables are not read.

C7.for_what_part: It shows that the undo works on a copy as of A2. It does not show that the worker kept the undo material, so the record has to show that nothing but the tidy call cleared it.

C8.for_what_part: It shows that the recipients are identical to those promoted and the wording identical to the approved wording, with the count to send. It does not show the orders actually made, which is left to A3.

C9.for_what_part: It shows the confirmed calls and those ordered and not confirmed, with their fingerprints against the release. It speaks only as of the time it was taken, and a call in doubt stays in doubt.

plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: C3, the category by the requester's rule, has no instrument. The rule is reserved to the requester and no answer returns it, so it cannot be told. C5, the reads, has no plan instrument. The scope of a call can be asked for only on named lines and is paid from the allowance of 50. C10, the outbox rows, has no plan instrument. The trace of a call can be asked for only on named lines at A3, at 10 for each line, so it is not possible for all 100 within the allowance. I would also have wanted live-table readings by same set and summary of the change.
